name: ProductListingVehicles
description: Creates a Vehicle product type with make and model, body style, year, mileage, fuel, drivetrain and color attributes, 28 sample vehicles, and a Vehicles listing page at /vehicles with filters, sorting and grid and list views. Some vehicles can be bought online and the rest are listed only.
author: CrestApps
